decisive_items: a 1.09 × 0.79 cm well-circumscribed hypoechoic lesion in the left testis with internal blood flow
serum CA19-9 level of 57.5 U/mL (normal <27 U/mL)
response.rationale: The presence of a well-circumscribed hypoechoic lesion with internal blood flow and elevated tumor marker levels is highly suggestive of testicular cancer.

rejected.why: Epididymal cysts are common and not directly related to the patient's primary complaint.
The absence of tenderness and the presence of a well-circumscribed lesion make testicular torsion less likely.
